data_testid_policy.rule: Every interactive element MUST have a unique kebab-case `data-testid` attribute.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Do not use generic gray boxes or standard Bootstrap/Vercel templates. Use deep navy canvas, electric neon glows, sharp grid lines, rich typography, and custom micro-interactions.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_emoji_icons: NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯). Use Lucide React icons exclusively.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.color_rules: DO NOT use dark colors as standard flat gradients. Keep dark navy clean (#070A12 / #0B1120) with subtle radial glowing glows (#00E5FF & #FF3366) and translucent cards with backdrop-blur.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.alignment: Do NOT add text-align: center globally to the app container. Align text naturally for clear reading hierarchy.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Use explicit CSS transitions on specific properties (e.g. transition-colors, transition-transform) rather than transition-all.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.image_usage: Only use the curated Unsplash URLs provided in image_urls. Never use placehold.it or via.placeholder.com.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_readiness: Every button, input, select, link, tab, and card must have a data-testid attribute.
